Make or convert to a BirdFlowIntervals object

Source: R/as_BirdFlowIntervals.R
as_birdflow_intervals.Rd

as_birdflow_intervals() is a generic function with two methods:

  • The BirdFlowRoutes method converts a BirdFlowRoutes object into a BirdFlowIntervals object, sampling interval pairs between time points. BirdFlowIntervals define specific movements between states in a BirdFlow model. The two points in each interval will always differ in time (week / timestep). They can occupy the same location (raster cell) in the model or represent a movement between two locations.

  • The data.frame method builds a BirdFlowIntervals object directly from an already-assembled interval data frame plus the associated species, metadata, geom, dates, and source components, without any sampling.

BirdFlowIntervals are primarily used to evaluate model performance with calc_interval_metrics().

Usage

as_birdflow_intervals(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'BirdFlowRoutes'
as_birdflow_intervals(
  x,
  max_n = 1000,
  min_day_interval = 7,
  max_day_interval = 180,
  min_km_interval = 200,
  max_km_interval = 8000,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'data.frame'
as_birdflow_intervals(x, species, metadata, geom, dates, source = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

Either a BirdFlowRoutes object or a data frame with interval data (see Routes-internal for the required columns).

...

Passed to methods.

max_n

The maximum number of intervals to sample. Defaults to 1000. Only used by the BirdFlowRoutes method.

min_day_interval

The minimum days required in an interval. Defaults to 7. Only used by the BirdFlowRoutes method.

max_day_interval

The maximum days required in an interval. Defaults to 180. Only used by the BirdFlowRoutes method.

min_km_interval

The minimum distance required for an interval. Defaults to 200. Only used by the BirdFlowRoutes method.

max_km_interval

The maximum distance required for an interval. Defaults to 2000. Only used by the BirdFlowRoutes method.

species

A list with species information. Only used by the data.frame method.

metadata

A list with additional metadata. Only used by the data.frame method.

geom

A list describing spatial geometry. Only used by the data.frame method.

dates

A data frame with date-related information. Only used by the data.frame method.

source

A character string indicating the source of the data. Only used by the data.frame method.

Value

A BirdFlowIntervals object.

See also

  • as_routes() for converting observational data into a formal Routes object

  • as_birdflow_routes() for converting Routes to BirdFlowRoutes.

Examples

route_df <- data.frame(
  route_id = c("001", "001", "001", "001", "001", "003",
  "003", "003", "004"),
  date = as.Date(c(
    "2025-01-01", "2025-01-08", "2025-01-15",
    "2025-01-21", "2025-02-10", "2025-03-01", "2025-05-01", "2025-06-01",
    "2025-05-01"
  )),
  lon = c(
    -75.0060, -75.0060, -74.0060, -87.6298, -87.6298, -87.6298,
    -89.6298, -85.6298, -95.3698
  ),
  lat = c(
    39.7128, 39.7128, 40.7128, 41.8781, 41.8781, 41.8781, 42.8781,
    40.8781, 29.7604
  ),
  route_type = c(
    "tracking", "tracking", "tracking", "tracking", "tracking",
    "motus", "motus", "motus", "motus"
  )
)
routes_obj <- as_routes(route_df, species = "amewoo")
# \donttest{
bf <- BirdFlowExamples::amewoo
birdflow_routes <- routes_obj |> as_birdflow_routes(bf = bf)
birdflow_intervals <- as_birdflow_intervals(birdflow_routes, max_n = 1000)
# }
